semiconductor_relevance: High — Jipal Corporation specializes in the distribution of semiconductor packaging and testing equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Jipal Corporation, established in 1990, focuses on distributing cutting-edge semiconductor packaging and testing equipment, as well as PCBA-related materials. With a strong presence across Asia, Jipal is committed to providing tailored solutions and exceptional after-sales support to its clients.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Jipal has its headquarters in Hsinchu, along with branches in Taichung and Kaohsiung.
regional_presence.China: The company operates in 17 cities across China, providing localized support.
regional_presence.Hong Kong: Jipal maintains a presence in Hong Kong to cater to regional clients.
regional_presence.Malaysia: Jipal has established operations in Malaysia to enhance its service offerings in Southeast Asia.
regional_presence.Thailand: The company has a presence in Thailand to support local semiconductor industries.
regional_presence.Vietnam: Jipal operates in Vietnam, contributing to the growing semiconductor market there.
regional_presence.India: Jipal has expanded its reach to India, aiming to serve the local semiconductor sector.
